Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Link helps Stripe's merchants deliver frictionless and secure checkout experiences by auto-filling customers' payment information, letting customers check out in seconds and pay in one click across the Link merchant network. 

What you'll do

We’re hiring a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design and delivery of new money-movement capabilities in Link. You will take ambiguous product opportunities and turn them into reliable, scalable, and intuitive experiences for consumers and merchants.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with broad technical and organizational scope. You will own large, cross-functional projects from early product and technical definition through launch and iteration; lead teams of engineers through complex execution; and partner closely with the many Stripe systems and teams that make money movement possible.

You will work across the stack, building services and APIs as well as the user experiences that expose those capabilities. The work may involve modern financial infrastructure—including stablecoin-enabled capabilities—while requiring sound judgment around safety, reliability, compliance, and user trust. You will make the architectural decisions that let the balance model scale globally, and raise the engineering bar for the team as we grow.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and execution for large, ambiguous Link initiatives that create new money-movement primitives.
  • Own projects end to end: clarify the problem, define an incremental technical plan, align stakeholders, drive delivery, launch safely, and use results to guide further investment.
  • Build robust, scalable backend services and high-quality consumer-facing experiences across Java, Ruby, and TypeScript.
  • Lead a project team of engineers through execution, creating clarity on priorities, decisions, risks, and delivery milestones.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Risk, Infrastructure, and other Stripe teams to build capabilities that are safe, reliable, and useful.
  • Navigate dependencies across Stripe’s payments and money-movement platforms, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, user experience, operational reliability, and durable technical foundations.
  • Raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, design reviews, mentoring, and constructive feedback across the team.
  • Help shape the team’s longer-term roadmap by identifying opportunities, technical risks, and investments needed to scale Link’s financial capabilities globally.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience, with a track record of owning large, ambiguous systems end-to-end.
  • Demonstrated technical experience leading the design and delivery of large, complex software projects from early definition through production launch.
  • Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience building reliable backend services and polished user-facing product experiences.
  • Experience leading and unblocking a group of engineers on a substantial project as a senior individual contributor.
  • Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, making durable technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward.
  • Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints.
  • Strong engineering judgment around system reliability, operational excellence, security, and maintainability.
  • A product-minded approach to engineering, with a focus on delivering meaningful outcomes for users and the business.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Java, Ruby, and/or TypeScript. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than expertise in a particular language or framework.
  • Experience building payments, money-movement, fintech, or other regulated financial products.
  • Experience building consumer products at scale, particularly products that require a high degree of user trust.
  • Experience working on 0→1 products or taking new capabilities from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins, digital assets, or the infrastructure that enables global financial products.
  • Appreciation for the importance of good documentation—internal and external—and taking pride in seeing projects through to successful completion

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot is financing a rapidly growing portfolio of data center developments, with a mix of project-level debt, corporate facilities, and capital markets executions. This role is primarily transaction driven, helping to execute on debt financings from initial lease review, financial modeling, preparing marketing materials, term sheet and lender negotiations, through to documentation, diligence, and financial close. Post funding responsibilities will be to support compliance and lender reporting across active facilities.

This is a hands-on, execution-oriented, relationship driven role with active cross functional workstreams with other leaders across Riot’s finance/corporate development, treasury, legal, accounting, and data center groups. The role will also serve as a liaison between Riot and and the lender and investor community, including banks, agents, rating agencies, and outside counsel.

This is a remote position with travel up to 25% travel for lender/investor meetings, site visits, Riot corporate off sites.

What you'll do

  • Execute on the capital markets strategy, supporting debt financings across the spectrum including construction loans, project finance, corporate facilities, and capital markets issuances.
  • Manage the deal process from end to end, across multiple concurrent workstreams: including structuring, financial modelling, negotiating, documentation, and closing.
  • Review financing and legal documents including term sheets, credit agreements, security and collateral documents, guarantees, hedging arrangements and related lease agreements.
  • Prepare lender and rating agency presentations, term sheet summaries, and materials for senior management, Board approvals and earnings presentations.
  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses across different financing structures or assumptions, capital costs, and equity requirements,
  • Monitor ongoing compliance and lender reporting across live facilities, including covenant calculations and compliance certificates.

What you'll have

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, accounting, engineering, mathematics, or a related field. CFA or MBA preferred.
  • 7-10+ years in investment banking, project or corporate finance, treasury and capital markets, leveraged finance, private equity or a similar role. Data center, power, energy or real estate experience preferred.
  • Advanced Excel skills in financial modeling (including cash flow modeling and debt mechanics) and strong PowerPoint skills.
  • Experience with project finance/bank market, high-yield, ABS or private placement debt, including a deep knowledge of the broader financial and capital markets and macroeconomic dynamic
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple deadlines at once, strong negotiator, and clear communication skills

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: $190,000-$200,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

GRVT is the only exchange architected on its own yield-generating, tokenized deposit layer — where every dollar is instantly transformed into a productive, yield-bearing asset. Capital compounds continuously across trading, investing, and spending, without ever leaving self-custody or going idle.

Where traditional exchanges force a tradeoff between yield generation and capital deployment, GRVT eliminates that constraint entirely. Tokenized deposits function simultaneously as margin, yield instruments, and liquidity primitives — compounding across the full lifecycle of capital, from fiat on-ramp to perpetuals trading, institutional vaults, and real-world spending.

Built on a dedicated privacy chain powered by zkSync Prividium, GRVT delivers CEX-grade performance with on-chain settlement — fully self-custodial by design. The company is founded by alumni from Goldman Sachs, Meta, and DBS.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Strong leadership, organizational, and project management skills.

  • Fluent in crypto culture, community dynamics, and user motivations.

Why Join GRVT?

  • Be part of redefining how the world accesses investments—on-chain, peer-powered, and borderless.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs is scaling fast, and our HRBP team is the connective tissue that keeps that growth healthy. As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will be a strategic partner to managers and senior leaders as we build a high-performance organization where every TRMer is engaged and operating at the top of their craft. You will coach, run org design, own performance and employee relations, and drive the programs that move retention. You will obsess over the metrics that matter: performance, business success, attrition and engagement, and turn people data into action in an AI-native culture. You will also build scalable systems and agentic workflows that provide our employees with bespoke, white-glove experiences that make TRM a meaningful place for them to grow their career.

The impact you will have:

  • Increase retention: build action plans and develop programs that drive down voluntary attrition and increase engagement

  • Drive organizational effectiveness: partner with senior leaders on how their organizations should run, scale and change via honest feedback.

  • Enable business outcomes: connect talent strategy with strategic priorities and help leaders see around corners, weigh costs, and evaluate people-related decisions.

  • Raise manager quality: provide ongoing coaching and targeted manager development programs.

  • Increase talent density: advise managers around team and individual performance.

  • Protect trust in the company: manage employee relations from intake to resolution, including investigations, documentation, and terminations.

  • Lift engagement: turn pulse survey results into action plans, at company and team level, and driving them with managers.

  • Shape the future of the organization: proactively lead org design and workforce planning and propose best-in-class compensation strategies to attract and retain top talent.

  • Keep people steady through change: guide leaders through restructures and fast-changing priorities, including when there's no playbook. Sequence the change and communicate it clearly.

  • Enable TRMers to have meaningful careers: build tools, frameworks, and programs that ensure our talent grow and develop.

  • Build white-glove experiences at scale: create systems and AI agents that support your own workflow and give employees, managers and leaders a fast, high-quality experience. Be AI-native, and show managers how.

What we’re looking for:

  • 7+ years in People/HR, including time as an HRBP advising managers and senior leaders.

  • A track record of coaching executives and managers through change and on a variety of people-related topics ranging from org design, talent density, performance culture, employee investigations, talent strategy, etc.

  • Experience leading change in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, including restructures where there is no playbook.

  • Sound judgment and high integrity in confidential, high-stakes situations.

  • A record of earning credibility with demanding technical and engineering teams.

  • Strategic range and a willingness to get hands-on. You can plan the org change and then run the first conversation.

  • Hands-on AI builder. You use AI daily and have built automations or agentic workflows for HRBP work. A tool you built for employees or managers, such as a career pathways tool, is a strong plus.

  • Fluent with people data: you know how and when to use quantitative and qualitative people insights to shape people strategy and to measure whether your work moved drove business impact.

  • Experience navigating multi-country employment is a plus.

About the Team:

  • TRM's People team partners with leaders across R&D, GTM and G&A to build a stunning team and culture. You would be one of three HRBPs working as strategic advisors to our leaders and managers, while also building scalable people programs across manager development, compensation, talent management, career growth, and performance.

  • The work is high-ownership and high-trust: you will make consequential people decisions that have direct impact on TRM’s future success and our ability to achieve our mission of making the world a safer place for billions of people.

  • You will be stretched to grow across all aspects of people strategy, with the opportunity to go deep and wide as we build out programs and centers of excellence.

  • The team operates in an AI-native culture where everyone is expected to use AI to raise their leverage.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team collaborates across time zones using Slack, Notion and Zoom.

  • Communication is async-first, with clear written context and strong meeting hygiene (every invite has an agenda).

  • Decisions are documented in Decision Docs and reviewed openly.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Minimum 4-hour overlap with US Pacific business hours; core collaboration 7am to 12pm PT.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional team offsites

  • Frequency: 2-4x a year

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within a week of engagement-survey results landing, turn them into action plans with leaders that enhance team performance.

  • Diagnose an underperformance case and have an action plan within 2 days.

  • Document and send next steps on a new employee relations case within 24 hours of it being raised.

  • Draft a retention plan within the hour after a stay conversation, and bring comp benchmarking and options when a key employee is at risk.

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - 192,000

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Mysten Labs’ mission is to advance the internet through step-function improvements in what technology makes possible. We build foundational infrastructure and products that give people, businesses, and developers new ways to interact, transact, and create value.

Our work spans on-chain finance and the emerging agent economy. Through Sui, Move, and our broader technology stack, we’re building the systems that make these experiences possible - from secure, scalable blockchain infrastructure to new ways for businesses and AI agents to interact.

Mysten Labs is looking for a hands-on Security Engineer with strong application security fundamentals and a track record of finding and fixing real vulnerabilities. You’ll own bug bounty programs and external audits, secure our code and software supply chain, and build tooling that protects Mysten’s products and users across the Sui ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Run Mysten's bug bounty programs: triage, severity, responses, internal escalations, fix validation, and the budget and payouts. Turn recurring report classes into automated checks.

  • Own audit engagements: scope and schedule external audits, act as the technical counterpart during the engagement, and track findings through remediation and fix validation.

  • Conduct code and design reviews of systems built by Mysten, its subsidiaries and partners (Rust, TypeScript, Move). Drive issues to conclusion, including investigation and incident response, and run variant analysis so each bug class is closed everywhere it occurs.

  • Own software supply chain security: dependency and CI/CD malware defenses, Endor Labs, the code security service (GitHub controls, merge bots), and the ongoing code security self-auditing service. Detect and respond to compromised packages, maintainers and build pipelines, and secure the provenance and signing of what Mysten ships.

  • Build and improve anti-scam and anti-abuse tooling for the Sui ecosystem: detect phishing sites, malicious dApps, drainer contracts and other threats that target Sui users, and work with wallet teams on mitigations.

  • Build security tooling: LLM-driven triage and review agents, and static and dynamic analysis (taint, call graphs, fuzzing) wired into CI and code review. Build in known-clean checks so people trust the results.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, application security or product security, with a track record of finding real vulnerabilities (bug bounty reports, audit findings, CVEs or published research).

  • Strong Web2 security fundamentals: XSS, CSRF, SSRF, authorization flaws, injection, deserialization, software supply chain failures, cryptographic failures.

  • Proficiency in one or more of Rust, TypeScript, Python or Move, and experience reviewing and writing security-sensitive code.

  • Hands-on knowledge of software supply chain attack surface: package ecosystems (npm, crates.io, PyPI), CI/CD (GitHub Actions workflow injection, token exposure, unpinned actions), and build provenance.

  • Solid understanding of applied cryptography fundamentals and the common ways cryptographic systems are misused in practice.

  • Experience on either side of a bug bounty program or an audit engagement.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to influence teams you have no formal authority over.

  • Interest in the web3 space is required.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Smart contract or wallet security: Move, Solidity or Rust-based chains; Sui's object and capability model is a plus.

  • Static or dynamic program analysis: CodeQL, Semgrep, taint analysis, fuzzing, symbolic execution.

  • Experience building security tooling with LLM agents (Claude Code skills or comparable), and a clear sense of where models help and where deterministic tooling has to do the work.

  • Anti-phishing, anti-fraud or trust & safety experience: domain and content monitoring, crawling, classifiers, threat intelligence.

  • Knowledge of recent crypto incidents and the defect classes behind them: drainer kits, DeFi frontend compromises, package-registry compromises.

  • Notable bug bounty rankings, CVEs, publications or conference talks.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which may include verification of employment history, education credentials, criminal history, and other relevant information.

Regarding the recent rash of technology job scams: Be aware that emails from genuine Mysten Labs group recruiters will always come from the @mystenlabs.com domain or related subdomains (e.g., mystenlabs.com/careers). Remember: you can always verify positions on our job boards at www.mystenlabs.com/careers.

To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

Our team is remote first and we are hiring across the world. Here at Mysten Labs, you’ll be joining a world-class team with tremendous growth potential as we bring the next billion users to web3. We raised a $300M Series B round from top Silicon Valley led venture funds like Jump Crypto, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Binance Labs, Redpoint, Lightspeed, Coinbase Ventures, Electric Capital, Standard Crypto, NFX, Slow Ventures, Scribble Ventures, Samsung Next, Lux Capital, among other investment firms and strategic partners. Come join us and build the future of web3!

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

Overview

We are looking for a Risk Product Analyst to work directly with Portfolio Managers, Traders, and Quantitative Researchers across multiple trading desks and asset classes.  The role sits at the intersection of trading, risk, and technology. 

You will be responsible for proactively identifying problems affecting our internal risk and valuation systems, diagnosing them by tracing the cause into the back-end services and infrastructure those systems depend on, and resolving them quickly and effectively.

This is a fast-paced, highly collaborative role that requires deep knowledge of products and markets, strong technical skills, and sound judgement under pressure.

Responsibilities

Partner directly with Portfolio Managers, Traders, and Quantitative Researchers across rates, FX, commodities, equities, and crypto asset classes, serving as their primary point of contact for issues affecting risk and valuation.

Diagnose and resolve issues affecting our next-generation risk and valuation systems, investigating across the full technology stack: applications, APIs, databases, messaging systems, and the underlying services that they depend on.

Monitor system and trading issues and prioritize incidents based on their potential impact to trading, portfolio management, and P&L.

When an issue cannot be resolved directly, identify the appropriate engineering, quantitative, or infrastructure team, and escalate with a clear, reproducible diagnosis that accelerates issue resolution.

Work closely with Engineering and Product Management teams to identify recurring problems and drive strategic technology solutions.

Develop tools and scripts in Python to automate diagnostics, investigate issues, analyze data, and improve workflows.

Build a strong understanding of the firm’s trading and risk infrastructure and the dependencies between systems and underlying services.

Qualifications

Deep knowledge of financial products (cash instruments, futures, swaps, options) and markets, backed by strong technical skills.

Previous experience in trade support, trading technology, production support, or a closely related role within a production trading environment – supporting multiple desks and/or asset classes.

Ability to write Python and SQL to investigate issues, automate diagnostics, and query and reconcile data across systems.

Familiarity with production diagnostic tooling (log aggregation, dashboards, monitoring, alerting).

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to methodically narrow down the source of an issue.

Ability to communicate effectively with a varied audience, including portfolio managers, traders, quantitative researchers, engineers, and product managers.

Who We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate combines strong market and product knowledge with technical depth and is commercially aware and comfortable operating at the intersection of trading and technology.

You should be able to take an instruction like “my risk numbers look wrong” and work through it independently by understanding what the front office is trying to do, investigating the relevant systems and services, determining where the failure is occurring, and either resolving it or routing it to the appropriate team with a clear diagnosis.

This is not a role where success is measured by closing support tickets.  We are looking for someone who understands the trading domain, can solve problems, and can build strong relationships with the people running the firm’s trading strategies.

The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.
